title: SuperWallet
tagline: SuperWallet is a secure, unified multi-chain transaction system, allowing users to initiate payments using coins/tokens across multiple chains simultaneously with ease
description:
Super Wallet is a cutting-edge platform designed to enable users to seamlessly manage their digital assets across various blockchain networks. Here's what Super Wallet offers:

Social Logins: Get started effortlessly by using your preferred social login platforms.

Smart Contract Wallets: Establish smart contract wallets on multiple blockchains, all managed under a singular wallet interface.

Cross-Chain Transactions: With Super Wallet, you can accept funds from any blockchain network and conveniently consolidate assets from diverse chains for transactions. For instance, merge 2 aUSDC from Avalanche with 5 aUSDC from Polygon to facilitate a 7 aUSDC payment on Mantle.

Single Signature Transactions: Leveraging the capabilities of smart contract wallets and Account Abstraction, you can execute all transactions with a singular user signature, ensuring a fluid and efficient user experience.
how_its_made:
Super Wallet leverages the power of Axelar GMP for streamlined cross-chain transactions and employs Biconomy SDK V2 for account abstraction. This enables users to execute multi-chain operations with just a single signature, optimizing the transaction process. The frontend of Super Wallet, developed using Next.js, ensures a user-friendly and intuitive experience. Furthermore, its integration with Particle Network offers simplified onboarding via social logins. For those keen on experimentation and exploration, Super Wallet extends support to various testnet networks, including Scroll Sepoli, Polygon Mumbai, Avalanche, and Mantle.
